description: This file defines a RecipeProvider class for managing a collection of recipes in a Flutter application. It includes sorting options, in-memory search/filtering logic, and utility methods for retrieving ingredients and performing searches without a backend.

classes.name: RecipeProvider
classes.description: Provides access to recipes and in-memory helpers for search, filter, and sort operations.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs an in-memory search over recipes with filtering by keyword, ingredients, max time, and sorting options.

methods.name: getAllIngredients
methods.description: Returns a list of all distinct, normalized ingredients from the dataset for filtering purposes.
